properties.description: The class gate for NEW-02: every required parameter on the served surface carries a non-empty description, with membership DERIVED from the served schema (sibling of every_reference_parameter_names_its_type) so a 181st tool joins it the moment it is served. Measured 76 of 230 bare on 2026-09-11; zero after increment 434. EXEMPT is empty and kept as a list, with a second test that refuses an entry naming a parameter no longer bare. Shown to fail — naming exactly `verifies.verification_id` — when one description was stripped, before it was trusted.
